title: DEMO — District Administration Traffic Advisory for SAS Nagar (Mohali)
rawContent:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY — DISTRICT ADMINISTRATION, SAS NAGAR (MOHALI)

Date: 02 October 2026
Time: 10:42 AM IST

Due to heavy rainfall and waterlogging in various parts of SAS Nagar district, the following traffic advisories are issued:

1. Airport Road (Mohali to Chandigarh Airport): CLOSED for light vehicles until further notice due to severe waterlogging. Heavy vehicles may still pass with extreme caution.

2. Sector 70-71 internal roads: Significant waterlogging reported. Residents advised to avoid non-essential travel.

3. Phase 7 Market Area: Partial waterlogging. Shops in low-lying areas advised to take precautionary measures.

4. Mohali-Kharar Road: Open but slow-moving traffic due to water on road shoulders.

Alternative Routes:
- Commuters heading towards Chandigarh may use the Zirakpur-Panchkula route via NH-5.
- Commuters heading towards Chandigarh University from Mohali may use the Kharar bypass road.

Helpline: 0172-XXXXXXX (DC Office SAS Nagar)

Situation is being monitored. Updates will be issued as conditions change.

(SIMULATED TRAFFIC ADVISORY FOR DEMONSTRATION PURPOSES)
